MARKETING SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 6 April 2026 between Vale & Hart Hospitality Limited, whose registered office is at 9 Longmarket Yard, Manchester M4 1HN (the "Client"), and Nadia Osei, trading as Osei Marketing, of 27 Cranleigh Place, Manchester M20 3BE (the "Contractor").

The parties agree as follows.

1. THE ENGAGEMENT

1.1 The Contractor shall plan and run the campaigns described in Schedule 1 for the Client's three restaurant sites (the "Deliverables").
1.2 The Contractor shall begin work on 13 April 2026 and shall deliver the last of the Deliverables by 9 October 2026 (the "Term").
1.3 The Contractor shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care.
1.4 This Agreement does not renew, and any further engagement of the Contractor requires a fresh written agreement signed by both parties.

2. HOW THE WORK IS DELIVERED

2.1 The Contractor shall deliver each campaign to the Client by the date shown against it in Schedule 1.
2.2 The Contractor shall deliver each campaign as a written plan, the creative assets it calls for, and a results report published two weeks after the campaign closes.
2.3 The Contractor shall carry out one round of revisions to each campaign plan at no additional charge.

3. CHANGES

3.1 A change to the Deliverables, to the Term or to the fee takes effect only once both parties have signed a written change order recording it.
3.2 Neither party may vary the fee or the scope of the Deliverables without the other party's written agreement.

4. FEES, ACCEPTANCE AND PAYMENT

4.1 The Client shall pay the Contractor £3,400 a month for the Deliverables, invoiced at the end of each month.
4.2 The Client shall notify the Contractor in writing within seven (7) days of delivery whether a Deliverable meets the acceptance criteria in Schedule 2, identifying by reference to those criteria anything that does not.
4.3 A Deliverable is treated as accepted if the Client gives no notice under clause 4.2 within that period.
4.4 The Client shall pay each invoice within fourteen (14) days of the date of the invoice.
4.5 The Client shall reimburse advertising spend the Contractor has agreed with the Client in writing before committing it.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 Each party shall keep confidential the other party's commercial and customer information disclosed to it under this Agreement, and shall use that information only for the purposes of this Agreement.
5.2 Clause 5.1 does not apply to information that is already public or that a party is required by law to disclose.

6. STATUS OF THE CONTRACTOR

6.1 The Contractor is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement makes the Contractor an employee, agent or partner of the Client.
6.2 The Contractor decides how and when to carry out the work, subject only to the delivery dates in Schedule 1.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

7.1 On payment in full for a campaign, the Contractor assigns to the Client the intellectual property rights in the creative assets delivered for that campaign.
7.2 The assignment in clause 7.1 covers those creative assets and nothing else, and the Contractor's own research methods and reporting templates remain the Contractor's property.

8. INDEMNITY AND LIABILITY

8.1 Each party shall indemnify the other against any claim brought by a third party to the extent that the claim arises from that party's own breach of this Agreement.
8.2 The total liability of each party under this Agreement is limited to the total fees payable under clause 4.
8.3 Nothing in this Agreement limits either party's liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud.

9. RESTRICTIONS AFTER THE TERM

9.1 For twelve (12) months after the end of the Term, the Contractor shall not provide marketing services to any business in the hospitality sector anywhere in the United Kingdom.
9.2 The Contractor accepts that the restriction in clause 9.1 is reasonable to protect the Client's business.

10. ENDING THIS AGREEMENT

10.1 Either party may end this Agreement by giving the other thirty (30) days' written notice.
10.2 Where the Client ends this Agreement under clause 10.1, the Client shall pay for every Deliverable accepted or delivered before the end date, for work in progress on the date of the notice, and a cancellation fee equal to one month's fee.
10.3 Clauses 5, 7, 8 and 9 survive the end of this Agreement.

11. NOTICES

11.1 A notice under this Agreement must be in writing and sent to the address shown at the head of this Agreement or to an email address the receiving party has given for the purpose.

12. WHOLE AGREEMENT

12.1 This Agreement is the whole agreement between the parties about the Deliverables and replaces any earlier proposal, quotation or discussion.

SCHEDULE 1 — THE CAMPAIGNS

Campaign 1: Spring set menu launch across the three sites, due 8 May 2026.
Campaign 2: Summer terrace and events programme, due 26 June 2026.
Campaign 3: Loyalty scheme relaunch, due 21 August 2026.
Campaign 4: Autumn and festive booking push, due 9 October 2026.

SCHEDULE 2 — ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

A Deliverable meets the acceptance criteria when all three of the following are true.
Criterion 1: The campaign plan names the audience, the channels and the budget for each site.
Criterion 2: Every creative asset is supplied in the sizes listed in the Client's channel note.
Criterion 3: The results report states bookings, covers and spend against the plan.

Signed for and on behalf of Vale & Hart Hospitality Limited.

Signed by Nadia Osei, trading as Osei Marketing.
